description: This file defines the interface ITestController in the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, including nested interfaces ITest, ICategory, and associated iterators, for testing and categorization purposes within the framework.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ITestController
classes.description: Interface for controlling and managing tests and categories within the framework, including setup, teardown, and retrieval methods.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ITestController::ITest
classes.description: Represents a test with execute, description, and name functionalities, and an iterator to traverse sub-tests.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ITestController::ICategory
classes.description: Represents a category containing tests, with methods to manage category lifecycle and access contained tests.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ITestController::ITest::IIterator
classes.description: Iterator interface to traverse test instances.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ITestController::ICategory::IIterator
classes.description: Iterator interface to traverse category instances.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes or prepares the test controller or category environment.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up or finalizes the test controller or category environment.

methods.name: Categories
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all categories.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Retrieves a specific category by name.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes a test with given parameters and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Provides a description of the test.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the test.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the initial position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the iterator is at a valid position.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Retrieves a test by name within a category.

methods.name: Tests
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the tests within a category.

methods.name: Test (by name)
methods.description: Accesses a specific test by its name.

methods.name: Name (for categories)
methods.description: Returns the name of the category.

methods.name: Category (by name)
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its name.
